environment.description: Application deployed on an EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2) behind an Application Load Balancer with default settings. The ALB has a single HTTPS listener forwarding to the target group on port 8080. No AWS WAF is associated with the ALB. The EC2 instance runs the Flask app via gunicorn with 4 workers. The instance has IAM role with S3 and reporting permissions. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0 to ALB and ALB-to-instance on 8080.
